status: Finite retrospective benchmark fixed before new baseline fitting and scoring; Sound Life outcomes were previously inspected
question: Does the original eight-module representation improve measured-neutrophil prediction over fixed immune-marker means with identical source training and target calibration budgets?
target: Measured CBC neutrophils percent; errors in percentage points
source: The same 125 exactly paired GSE157103 hospital records used in stage53; not an AD or healthy-control cohort
locked8: Unmodified stage53 age/sex + eight signed-module source model
marker7: Age/male/sex_missing plus seven fixed means of log2(TPM+1) across the 61 stage53 immune marker genes; a marker-based ridge baseline, not the full MCP-counter implementation
source_preprocessing: StandardScaler fit on the same source125 only; no target feature scaling; locked8 gene standardization and missing-gene treatment unchanged
target_expression: All 58302 GRCh38.91 gene counts divided by exact saved exon-union lengths, with all-gene denominator, then TPM; extract fixed 61 marker genes for the same94 primary visits
primary_external_roles: Unmodified stage54 earliest eligible visit per subject: 20 fixed calibration subjects and 74 subject-disjoint evaluation subjects
calibration_rules: Each source model first clipped to [0,100]; intercept is mean(y-p) in identical20; affine is OLS y=a+b*p in identical20; calibrated outputs clipped to [0,100]
constant_comparator: Mean of the same20 calibration outcomes
primary_comparison: 74-subject MAE gain of locked8 over marker7 under matched intercept-only calibration: mean(abs(y-marker7)-abs(y-locked8))
primary_success_rule: Primary paired participant-bootstrap 95% CI for MAE gain lies entirely above zero; this would support superiority only for this retrospective cohort and budget
secondary: All three regimes for all models; R2, MAE, RMSE, Spearman, bias; matched age/sex comparisons and age strata <45 versus >=45 are descriptive

bootstrap.unit: one independent subject per primary visit
bootstrap.conditional_on: fixed source fit and fixed20 calibration subjects; does not include calibration-group selection uncertainty

no_adaptive_search: No combined8+7 or nonlinear rescue models
stop_rule: If marker baseline equals or outperforms locked8, report the result and prioritize a genuinely new measured external resource
claim_boundaries: Not a new untouched test cohort
Not validated AD diagnosis or AD triage improvement
No measured CBC prediction claim on AD microarrays
No general algorithm novelty or superiority from one comparison
